spell.wizardry_restored.lightning_bolt.d: Calls a bolt of lightning down on the spot you are pointing at. Needs open sky.
spell.wizardry_restored.sixth_sense.desc: Reveals every creature around you, even through walls, for a short while.
spell.wizardry_restored.shockwave.desc: Unleashes a blast of force that hurls everything around you away.
spell.wizardry_restored.snowball.desc: Throws a snowball where you point.
spell.wizardry_restored.mine.desc: Breaks the block you are looking at. More potency breaks harder blocks.
spell.wizardry_restored.mind_trick.desc: Confuses the target: it forgets whom it was fighting and grows weak.
spell.wizardry_restored.blink.desc: Instantly teleports you a short distance to where you point.
spell.wizardry_restored.intimidate.desc: A terrifying growl makes nearby creatures drop their target and flee.
spell.wizardry_restored.glide.desc: Hold to glide forward instead of falling.
spell.wizardry_restored.ironflesh.desc: Your skin turns to iron: much tougher, but slower.
spell.wizardry_restored.diamondflesh.des: Your skin turns to diamond: almost nothing gets through.
spell.wizardry_restored.greater_fireball: Launches a large fireball that explodes on impact.
Lightning strikes the target and jumps to nearby enemies, twice.
spell.wizardry_restored.paralysis.desc: A bolt that paralyses the target for a few seconds.
spell.wizardry_restored.summon_iron_gole: Summons an iron golem to fight for you for a while.
